findings: The systems field mixes full bidding systems with conventions and treatments.
Mention-based enrichment appears to have assigned systems from prose or references rather than article applicability.
Eleven non-bidding articles have populated systems values.
Some system articles list 10 to 14 unrelated systems or conventions.
Most empty values are on play articles where systems metadata is not applicable.

examples.finding: Contains unrelated systems and conventions in addition to Precision.
A play index is incorrectly labeled from a term mention.
A reference article is labeled with terms it documents.

recommended_policy.name: strict_applicability
recommended_policy.definition: systems lists only complete bidding systems or system families that the article directly defines or specifically applies to; ordinary play/reference/index articles remain empty.

recommended_sequence: Approve a strict meaning and controlled system taxonomy
Generate a removal-first repair plan for clearly inapplicable assignments
Review bidding articles for explicit system applicability
Do not fill empty play/reference systems lists
Add validation that rejects non-taxonomy values and flags unlikely non-bidding assignments
Apply reviewed changes with backups and regenerate the cache
